title: Application fee and admissions criteria — Steinberg
shortTitle: Application fee and admissions criteria — Steinberg
summary: A medical-school applicant pays a fee in reliance on stated evaluation criteria and alleges that different criteria were used.
notes: What performance did the institution promise in exchange for the fee? Distinguish a promise to evaluate in a particular way from a promise to admit. Identify the alleged acceptance and the effect of the published terms.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 229. Open assigned page 229.
